name: Do I need to prime my walls before painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to prime my walls before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Priming walls before painting is often recommended, especially when changing a dark color to a light one, painting over stains, or working with new drywall. Primer helps seal the surface, promotes better paint adhesion, and ensures a more uniform finish. It can save time and paint by reducing the number of coats needed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Priming is often recommended for new drywall, color changes, or covering stains to ensure better paint adhesion and a uniform finish.
